stem: Which statement describes a common theory regarding the third-party candidacy of Ross Perot in the U.S. presidential election of 1992?

options.label: A
options.text: Perot gained votes from traditionally Republican voters, which enabled Democrat Bill Clinton to win the electoral vote.

options.label: B
options.text: Perot was unable to win votes because he was not listed as a candidate on all state ballots.

options.label: C
options.text: Perot gained votes from traditionally Democratic voters, which allowed Republican George H. W. Bush to win the popular vote.

options.label: D
options.text: Perot was not a fair candidate because the process he used for his campaign was unconstitutional.
